title: Sword
summary: A stylized arming sword focused on crisp silhouette, layered material separation, and a more fantastical glass-and-metal read.

seo.title: Sword asset
seo.description: Realtime hero asset study with stylized glass-and-metal treatment.

interactive.note: Source geometry exists, but the main portfolio now treats interactive specimens as an optional secondary experience.

caseStudy.hook: A compact hero asset designed to read quickly in realtime-friendly presentation.
brief: The main goal was to build a weapon with enough fantasy detail to feel premium without losing clear silhouette.

sections.title: Silhouette and material split
body: The shape language stays clean so the more stylized material choices still feel legible.
Glass, metal, and wrap details were separated to keep the asset useful beyond a flat portfolio render.

outcomes: A stronger reference for premium fantasy asset work
